title: Peek does not work when viewing Gallery in File Explorer

judgment.rationale: The report establishes the version, Store installation, Peek module, and a Gallery/Space-bar symptom, but it does not identify whether the failure is limited to Gallery items, all File Explorer selections, or a shortcut/preview-handler path. The current discussion requests concrete reproduction detail, and no diagnostic archive or follow-up evidence is present.
evidence: The reporter uses PowerToys v0.101.2362.0 from the Microsoft Store.
The report names Peek and says the failure occurs in Gallery in File Explorer when the Space-bar shortcut is pressed.
The expected result is that the Peek panel opens; the actual result is that nothing happens.
No bug report ZIP, screenshot, video, Windows version, File Explorer build, or follow-up reproduction detail is attached.
The latest upstream activity is the automated triage request for concrete reproduction steps at 2026-09-25T06:10:40Z.
judgment.recommended_action: Request a numbered reproduction that distinguishes Gallery selection from ordinary File Explorer selection and captures a fresh diagnostic ZIP immediately after reproducing.

fix_assessment.rationale: A repository fix cannot be proposed until the failing activation path is distinguished from a shortcut, preview-handler, focus, or Gallery-specific selection issue.

issue_context.summary: Peek does not open when the reporter presses Space in File Explorer's Gallery view, but the report does not yet establish whether the problem is Gallery-specific or affects Peek activation more generally.
known_information: PowerToys v0.101.2362.0 is installed from the Microsoft Store.
The reported sequence is to browse Gallery in File Explorer with Peek enabled and press the Space-bar activation shortcut.
The expected result is a Peek panel; the observed result is no visible response.
The issue has no attached diagnostic ZIP and no author follow-up beyond the original report.
inferences: The failure may be related to how File Explorer Gallery exposes the selected item or focus, but this is not confirmed.
A shortcut-specific, preview-handler, or global Peek activation failure remains possible because the report does not compare Gallery with a normal folder or another supported file.
issue_context.analysis: The existing report is useful enough to request discriminating evidence, but not enough to select an owning code path or claim a root cause. The next response should compare the same Space-bar action in Gallery and an ordinary folder, identify the selected item type, and capture diagnostics immediately after each failing attempt.
initial_investigation: Read the complete issue body, labels, and current discussion.

information_gaps.how_to_collect: Please reproduce once in Gallery and once in a normal folder, recording the selected item type and the result of each Space-bar press.

information_gaps.information: The Windows version and build running the affected File Explorer session.

actions.label: Request Gallery Peek repro and diagnostics

comment.body:
Thanks for reporting this with the PowerToys version and the Gallery/Space-bar symptom. Please provide:
1. A numbered comparison: select one item in File Explorer Gallery and press Space with Peek enabled, then select a supported file in an ordinary folder and press Space. For each attempt, state the item type and whether the Peek panel opens.
2. Your Windows version and build (from Settings > System > About or winver).
3. Reproduce the failure once more and immediately add a comment containing /bugreport so the generated ZIP captures the activation failure.
These details will distinguish a Gallery-specific selection/focus problem from a general Peek activation or shell-integration failure.

status.detail: The report confirms a Gallery/Space-bar symptom but lacks a comparison repro, Windows build, and fresh diagnostics needed to identify the failing Peek activation path.
